recentItems.title: Peking Opera Blues | FULL MOVIE | Tsui Hark | Action Comedy
recentItems.description:
PEKING OPERA BLUES | Tsui Hark | Action, Comedy, Period Film https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBrrfZs-ew7PDeUmZnKLErFZF-_wyeDn4

The movie is set in chaotic 1920's China, when warlords fought each other for power while Sun Yat-Sen's underground movement tried to establish a democratic republic. The movie tells the story of three young women and two young men who are thrown together. One young woman grabs a box of jewels during the looting when one warlord takes Peking. A deserting soldier joins her, but the jewels end up at the Peking Opera. Here we meet the daughter of the head of the troupe, who dreams of being an actress. But even female roles are played by men in the opera. Soon, the daughter of the currently ruling warlord and a male agent of the democratic underground are involved. Peking Opera Blues stars Brigitte Lin, Sally Yeh, Cherie Chung, Mark Cheng, Kwok-Keung Cheung, Wu Ma, and Kenneth Tsang, and is directed by Tsui Hark.

recentItems.title: Cobra Verde | FULL MOVIE I Werner Herzog, Klaus Kinski | Adventure Drama
recentItems.description:
COBRA VERDE | Werner Herzog, Klaus Kinski | Adventure, Drama, Arthouse https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBrrfZs-ew7P0N9nUwg_mdvgfMP37hXJr

The feared bandit Cobra Verde is hired by a plantation owner to supervise his slaves. After the owner suspects Cobra Verde of consorting with his young daughters, the owner wishes him gone. Rather than kill him, the owner sends Cobra Verde to Africa. The only white man in the area, Cobra Verde finds himself the victim of torture and humiliation. Later, he trains soldiers in a rebel army. Far from home, Cobra Verde is on the edge of madness. Directed by Werner Herzog, Cobra Verde stars Klaus Kinski, King Ampaw, José Lewgoy, Salvatore Basile, Peter Berling, Guillermo Coronel, Nana Agyefi Kwame II, Nana Fedu Abodo, Kofi Yerenkyi, and Kwesi Fase.

recentItems.title: False Witness | FULL MOVIE | Phylicia Rashad, Philip Michael Thomas | Drama
recentItems.description:
FALSE WITNESS | Phylicia Rashad, Philip Michael Thomas | Drama https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBrrfZs-ew7MKmiG4p44Opeh7bqBDNotd

A popular New Orleans talk show hostess is slashed and left for dead. Investigator Marsh and his lover, Assistant District Attorney Jacobi, are determined to solve the case in an effort to boost Jacobi's impending promotion. As Marsh digs for clues in the seamy singles bars the victim frequented, Jacobi's instincts pull her towards the home of a respected surgeon who the talk show hostess identified as her attacker when she was brought into the operating room. False Witness stars Phylicia Rashad, Philip Michael Thomas, Teri Austin, George Grizzard, Robin Mattson, Joycelyn O'Brien, John Bennett Perry, James Sutorius, and more.
